newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: La Tondena Jan-Mar net sharply up.
newsitem.headline: La Tondena Jan-Mar net sharply up.

text.p: La Tondena Distillers Inc, the liquor and mineral water subsidiary of San Miguel Corp, said on Wednesday it posted an 84 percent increase in net income for the first quarter to 207 million pesos from the year-ago 113 million.
La Tondena said in a statement its net sales for the first quarter rose by 20 percent to 2.3 billion pesos compared with 1.9 billion the previous year.
Improved sales volume and price adjustments boosted the company's sales, La Tondena said.
The firm said while sales volume for its hard liquor and bottled water products rose, its juice drink sales dipped.
The operation of a new production line at its Cebu facility in the central Philippines will likely lift sales of its juice products, the company said.
